I could have waited and rested, going back a few days later than expected. As an intern(实习生), I felt the urge to [43] myself. So I looked for [44] to get back to the office in Jenbach [45]. The only option was a train journey requiring transfers(换乘), which I'd never [46] before. When the train rolled out of Thurso station, I couldn't imagine how much I would [47] my first train ride.
Between Thurso and Inverness, I was amazed at the [48]. The train passed through wild highlands, rocky coasts and ancient villages. [49], this line is not even regarded as Scotland's prettiest train route. That [50] goes to the route between Glasgow and Mallaig. And as the train moved forward, I found myself [51] actively, exchanging thoughts and even snacks with fellows.
A train journey takes longer than flying; that's its [52]. You never know what will surprise you as the train travels through station after station. The [53] journey provides a perfect time for relaxation, which people always [54] due to the tight schedule. The journey took me over one day; it was tiring yet [55]. I completed my task, and discovered a new way of traveling.

questions.explanation: 根据前文作者被派往苏格兰北部报道冲浪比赛，以及后文想方设法回到(get back to)办公室可知，这里指在作者“返回”之前火山爆发了。此处需填入表示“返回”的动词。
questions.supplement:
A(arrived)：语境句：We arrived at the airport two hours before departure. 固定搭配：arrive at/in, arrive late
B(returned)：语境句：He returned to his hometown after graduating from university. 固定搭配：return to, in return
C(settled)：语境句：After years of traveling, they finally settled in a quiet village. 固定搭配：settle down, settle a dispute
D(reported)：语境句：The journalist reported the accident live from the scene. 固定搭配：report on, it is reported that

questions.explanation: 因为火山爆发所有航班停飞(All planes were grounded)，这导致作者被“困住”了。be stuck表示“被困住，陷入僵局”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(lost)：语境句：The little boy got lost in the crowded market. 固定搭配：get lost, be lost in thought
B(scared)：语境句：She was scared to death when she heard the weird noise. 固定搭配：be scared of, be scared to do
C(stuck)：语境句：We were stuck in heavy traffic for over an hour. 固定搭配：be/get stuck in, stuck with
D(desperate)：语境句：The desperate parents appealed for help to find their missing child. 固定搭配：be desperate for, be desperate to do

questions.explanation: 作为一名实习生(intern)，作者本来可以多等几天再回，但为了表现自己，作者迫切地想要“证明”自己(prove oneself)。
questions.supplement:
A(prove)：语境句：He worked hard to prove himself capable of the job. 固定搭配：prove oneself, prove to be
B(test)：语境句：The difficult situation will test our courage and patience. 固定搭配：stand the test of time, put to the test
C(free)：语境句：Technology has freed us from heavy physical labor. 固定搭配：free sb from, set sb free
D(praise)：语境句：The teacher praised the student for his excellent performance. 固定搭配：praise sb for sth, sing the praises of

questions.explanation: 航班取消了，为了按时回办公室，作者不得不寻找“替代方案(alternatives)”，即其他的交通方式。
questions.supplement:
A(alternatives)：语境句：Since the road is blocked, we have no alternatives but to take a detour. 固定搭配：have no alternative but to do, provide an alternative
B(appointments)：语境句：I have an appointment with my dentist this afternoon. 固定搭配：make an appointment, keep an appointment
C(adventures)：语境句：The young man set off on a thrilling adventure in the jungle. 固定搭配：a sense of adventure, go on an adventure
D(admissions)：语境句：Gaining admission to a top university requires great effort. 固定搭配：apply for admission, gain admission to

questions.explanation: 作者想要证明自己是一个尽责的实习生，因此急切寻找替代方案是为了能“按时(on time)”回到办公室。
questions.supplement:
A(by air)：语境句：Traveling by air is usually faster than by train. 固定搭配：travel by air, send by air
B(on time)：语境句：The train departed exactly on time despite the bad weather. 固定搭配：arrive on time, finish on time
C(at ease)：语境句：His comforting words made me feel entirely at ease. 固定搭配：feel at ease, put sb at ease
D(beyond doubt)：语境句：His dedication to the project is beyond doubt. 固定搭配：beyond doubt, without doubt

questions.explanation: 唯一选择是乘坐需要多次换乘的火车，这是作者以前从未“经历(experienced)”过的。
questions.supplement:
A(opposed)：语境句：Many local residents strongly opposed the building of the factory. 固定搭配：be opposed to, oppose doing sth
B(forgot)：语境句：I completely forgot to turn off the lights before leaving. 固定搭配：forget to do, forget doing
C(completed)：语境句：She successfully completed her project ahead of schedule. 固定搭配：complete a task, complete with
D(experienced)：语境句：He experienced many hardships during his early years. 固定搭配：experience failure, fully experienced

questions.explanation: 从下文描述的沿途美景和带来的放松感可知，这趟旅程远超预期。作者在火车开出时，无法想象自己日后会有多“珍视(value)”这第一次火车之旅。
questions.supplement:
A(value)：语境句：I highly value your advice on my career choices. 固定搭配：value highly, value friendship
B(expand)：语境句：The company is planning to expand its business into overseas markets. 固定搭配：expand on, expand business
C(advocate)：语境句：Many experts advocate rewarding children for good behavior. 固定搭配：advocate doing sth, strongly advocate
D(affect)：语境句：The unexpected rain will certainly affect our outdoor activities. 固定搭配：deeply affect, negatively affect

questions.explanation: 后一句提到“火车穿过了荒野高地、多岩石的海岸和古老的村庄”，这些都属于自然“风景(scenery)”。作者对沿途风景感到惊叹。
questions.supplement:
A(facility)：语境句：The hotel offers excellent sports facilities for its guests. 固定搭配：public facilities, medical facilities
B(speed)：语境句：The car was traveling at a very high speed when the accident happened. 固定搭配：at top speed, speed up
C(atmosphere)：语境句：The restaurant is famous for its romantic atmosphere. 固定搭配：create an atmosphere, friendly atmosphere
D(scenery)：语境句：We stopped on the way to admire the spectacular mountain scenery. 固定搭配：beautiful scenery, enjoy the scenery

questions.explanation: 前文刚提到沿途风景绝美令作者惊叹，本句却说这条线甚至不被认为是苏格兰最美的火车路线。前后形成转折与预期反差，故填“令人惊讶地(Surprisingly)”。
questions.supplement:
A(Interestingly)：语境句：Interestingly, the twins have completely different personalities. 固定搭配：interestingly enough, interestingly written
B(Naturally)：语境句：Naturally, parents want the best for their children. 固定搭配：come naturally to, naturally occurring
C(Surprisingly)：语境句：Surprisingly, he passed the difficult exam with flying colors. 固定搭配：surprisingly well, somewhat surprisingly
D(Fortunately)：语境句：Fortunately, no one was injured in the terrible car crash. 固定搭配：fortunately for sb, turn out fortunately

questions.explanation: 前一句提到“最美路线”这个头衔，本句承接说这一“荣誉(honour)”属于格拉斯哥到马莱格的路线。go to表示“属于，被归于”。
questions.supplement:
A(reward)：语境句：Hard work will eventually bring you a great reward. 固定搭配：in reward for, as a reward
B(honour)：语境句：It is a great honour to be invited to speak at the conference. 固定搭配：in honour of, have the honour to do
C(secret)：语境句：The secret to success lies in persistence and hard work. 固定搭配：keep a secret, the secret to
D(opportunity)：语境句：You should seize the opportunity to study abroad. 固定搭配：take the opportunity, provide an opportunity

questions.explanation: 空后紧跟的动作是“与同车人交流思想甚至交换零食(exchanging thoughts and even snacks with fellows)”，这是在积极地进行“互动(interacting)”。
questions.supplement:
A(wandering)：语境句：He spent the afternoon wandering aimlessly around the city. 固定搭配：wander around, wander off
B(working)：语境句：She has been working tirelessly on this project for months. 固定搭配：work out, work on
C(interacting)：语境句：Children learn a lot by interacting with their peers. 固定搭配：interact with, interact closely
D(changing)：语境句：The world is changing at an unprecedented pace. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change for the better

questions.explanation: 坐火车比坐飞机耗时更长，正常情况下是缺点，但后文说它提供了惊喜和放松的完美时间，说明作者认为耗时长反而是火车旅行的“吸引力/魅力(appeal)”。
questions.supplement:
A(appeal)：语境句：The quiet countryside has lost its appeal for the young people. 固定搭配：have wide appeal, lose its appeal
B(power)：语境句：Knowledge is power, which can change a person's destiny. 固定搭配：come to power, in one's power
C(fault)：语境句：It is not your fault that the machine stopped working. 固定搭配：find fault with, at fault
D(challenge)：语境句：Learning a new language is a great challenge but highly rewarding. 固定搭配：face a challenge, meet a challenge

questions.explanation: 结合上一段“A train journey takes longer...”以及本段末尾“The journey took me over one day”，可知这是一段“延长的、漫长的(extended)”旅程，恰好给了人们充足的时间放松。
questions.supplement:
A(expected)：语境句：The results were better than we had expected. 固定搭配：be expected to do, as expected
B(extended)：语境句：He took an extended leave from work to care for his sick mother. 固定搭配：extended family, extended period
C(predictable)：语境句：The movie's plot was entirely predictable from the very beginning. 固定搭配：highly predictable, easily predictable
D(variable)：语境句：The weather in spring is highly variable and hard to forecast. 固定搭配：variable costs, highly variable

questions.explanation: 由于日程安排紧凑(tight schedule)，人们通常会把放松这件事“推迟(put off)”。火车旅行由于时间长，强制给人提供了这段放松时间。
questions.supplement:
A(rely on)：语境句：You can always rely on him to help you out in emergencies. 固定搭配：rely heavily on, rely on oneself
B(refer to)：语境句：The speaker often referred to his notes during the presentation. 固定搭配：refer to A as B, in reference to
C(care about)：语境句：True friends care about your feelings and support you unconditionally. 固定搭配：care deeply about, not care less about
D(put off)：语境句：Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today. 固定搭配：put off doing sth, be put off by

questions.explanation: 这段旅程花了一天多，很累人(tiring)，但句中有转折词yet，且后文说“我完成了任务并发现了新的旅行方式”，说明作者觉得这趟旅程是“值得的(worthwhile)”。
questions.supplement:
A(heartwarming)：语境句：The documentary tells a heartwarming story of a stray dog finding a home. 固定搭配：a heartwarming story, heartwarming news
B(flexible)：语境句：We need a more flexible schedule to accommodate sudden changes. 固定搭配：flexible working hours, highly flexible
C(worthwhile)：语境句：Volunteering at the hospital proved to be a worthwhile experience. 固定搭配：worthwhile effort, make sth worthwhile
D(inspirational)：语境句：The coach gave an inspirational speech before the championship game. 固定搭配：inspirational quote, inspirational figure

section_2_word_form.passage:
Du Fu is to Chinese literature what Shakespeare is to English literary tradition, and the great poet who wrote in the eighth century during the Tang dynasty [56] (quote) widely in China today. Unlike English literature of that period — think Beowulf, which is not understood and read by readers of modern English, Du Fu's poetry remains a classic easy [57] (understand) for modern Chinese readers.
However, no complete translation of his work was [58] (access) to foreigners until Stephen Owen, a Harvard professor, completed the six-volume, 3,000-page translation of The Poetry of Du Fu in 2016, [59] challenging task which took him 10 years to finish. In order to preserve [60] (various) in the collection's poetic voices, Owen thought of himself translating a great play with many characters. Doing it all himself, he explained, [61] (allow) him to notice literary allusions(典故) across centuries, linking each text back to earlier works. Those references can easily be lost, and this is [62] happens when a scholar-translator only works on a single volume.
Usually [63] (consider) one of the most challenging works to translate, Du Fu's collection of poetry features breadth in many aspects, whether in the choice of the subject, the way he conveys(传达) different registers [64] the use of layered meanings. Owen's critical translation faces the original texts, [65] (bring) a scholarly aid for the first time to English-speaking readers ready to engage with China's literary lion.

questions.explanation: 考查动词的时态和语态。主语是the great poet (指代杜甫)，与动词quote(引用)是被动关系；同时由时间状语today可知，应用一般现在时的被动语态。
questions.supplement: 正确形(is quoted)：语境句：Confucius is quoted widely by scholars all over the world. 固定搭配：quote from, quote sb as saying。原词quote其它变形：quotation(n. 引语), misquote(v. 误引)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。此处是“形容词(easy) + 不定式(to do)”结构，表示主语在某方面具备某种特征。杜甫的诗对于现代读者来说是“容易去理解的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to understand)：语境句：The instructions are clear and easy to understand. 固定搭配：easy to understand, difficult to understand。原词understand其它变形：understanding(n./adj. 理解/善解人意的), understandable(adj. 可理解的)

questions.explanation: 考查形容词转换。在系动词was后作表语，且搭配介词to，be accessible to意为“对……来说是可理解的/可获得的”。给出词access需变为形容词accessible。
questions.supplement: 正确形(accessible)：语境句：The museum is fully accessible to people in wheelchairs. 固定搭配：be accessible to, easily accessible。原词access其它变形：access(n./v. 接近/获取), inaccessibility(n. 不可达)

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。空格处引导同位语“___ challenging task...”，用以解释说明前面的translation(翻译工作)。task是可数名词单数，且此处表泛指“一项具有挑战性的任务”，用不定冠词a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：Completing the marathon was a challenging task for him. 固定搭配：a challenging task, a variety of。相关辨析：a用在辅音音素开头前，an用在元音音素开头前。

questions.explanation: 考查名词转换。作动词preserve(保留)的宾语，需要用名词形式。表示“保留诗歌声音的多样性”，various对应的名词是variety。
questions.supplement: 正确形(variety)：语境句：The shopping mall offers a wide variety of goods. 固定搭配：a variety of, cultural variety。原词various其它变形：variously(adv. 不同地), vary(v. 变化)

questions.explanation: 考查谓语动词。句子主语是动名词短语Doing it all himself，插入语是he explained，本空缺谓语动词。结合全文讲述斯蒂芬·欧文过去翻译杜甫诗集的事迹，应用一般过去时。
questions.supplement: 正确形(allowed)：语境句：The scholarship allowed her to continue her education abroad. 固定搭配：allow sb to do sth, allow for。原词allow其它变形：allowance(n. 津贴), allowable(adj. 允许的)

questions.explanation: 考查名词性从句。空处引导表语从句，且在从句中作happens的主语，表示“……的事情”，故填what。
questions.supplement: 正确形(what)：语境句：What you said yesterday really touched my heart. 固定搭配：what happens, what to do。相关辨析：that在名词性从句中不充当成分，what充当主宾表语。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词作状语。逻辑主语是Du Fu's collection of poetry，它与consider之间是被动关系（被认为），故用过去分词形式表示被动和状态。
questions.supplement: 正确形(considered)：语境句：Considered a masterpiece, the painting is highly valued by collectors. 固定搭配：be considered to be/as, all things considered。原词consider其它变形：consideration(n. 考虑), considerable(adj. 相当大的)

questions.explanation: 考查连词。前文有whether引导条件状语从句“whether in the choice of the subject, the way he conveys different registers...”，这里列举了三个方面，固定句型是whether A, B or C（不管是A、B还是C）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(or)：语境句：We have to decide whether to stay here or leave immediately. 固定搭配：whether...or..., either...or...。相关辨析：and表并列递进，or表选择。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。逗号前句子结构完整(Owen's translation faces texts)，此处表示伴随的结果或状态，翻译本身“带来”帮助，为主动关系，故用现在分词。
questions.supplement: 正确形(bringing)：语境句：The heavy rain lasted for days, bringing severe floods to the area. 固定搭配：bring about, bring up。原词bring其它变形：brought(过去式/过去分词)
